_about: karma's reads on players that the numbers can't see. Kept by hand. 'motor': high-intensity player whose output rises with his minutes; never take an under on him when a starter at his position is out. 'small_ball_5': plays centre in small lineups, so there is rebound upside when the bigs sit. 'primary_guard_defender': guards the opponent's main ball-handler, so his minutes hold up whatever happens to his shooting.

Baylor Scheierman.note: High-intensity player, maximises any minutes he gets (karma, 5 Nov 2026). Started for the resting Tatum on 4 Nov: 29 min, 9 pts, 11 reb; our under 12.5 PR lost. The model had him at 24.6 min and 4.5 reb.

Mario Hezonja.note: Big role for now (karma, 6 Nov). Peyton Watson has a nagging hamstring and could be in and out of the lineup all season. Hezonja is probably CLE's best defender on opposing primary guards, which keeps his minutes steady, and he plays the 5 when they go small, which is where the rebounds come from. Rebounding above his minutes: 31 Oct 20 min, 11 reb; 2 Nov 27 min, 12/8; 4 Nov 23 min, 12/8 after Allen left injured in Q1.
Mario Hezonja.review: 2026-12-01 (Watson coming back no longer ends the role on its own, given the nagging hamstring)
